slide1.title: Save Pages Instantly
slide1.description: Share from any browser or paste a URL. Quick save with 'use copied link' shortcut.

slide2.title: Read Immediately
slide2.description: Start reading while content processes in background. No waiting required.

slide3.title: Read Anywhere
slide3.description: All content stored locally. Read offline after processing completes.

slide4.title: Distraction-Free
slide4.description: Scripts removed, reader-focused styles applied. Clean reading experience.

slide5.title: Make It Yours
slide5.description: Customize themes, font size, line height, and margins for perfect readability.

slide6.title: Beautiful Library
slide6.description: Automatic cover image extraction creates a visually rich reading collection.

slide7.title: Stay Organized
slide7.description: Favorites, Archive tabs. Rename and delete with long-press.

slide8.title: Find Anything
slide8.description: Full-text search with highlighted snippets and recent search history.

slide9.title: Plan Your Reading
slide9.description: Estimated reading time shown on every article.

slide10.title: Never Miss Content
slide10.description: Failed downloads retry automatically when connection returns.

slide11.title: Your Language
slide11.description: Choose from 32+ languages for the interface.

slide12.title: Storage Control
slide12.description: View storage usage and clear cache with one tap.

slide13.title: Tactile Feedback
slide13.description: Optional haptic responses for button presses and interactions.

slide14.title: Your Privacy Matters
slide14.description: Zero data collection. Everything stays on your device.
